annotations.title: Cascade a chain's maker S-parameter files

description: Cascade a chain's parts from maker .s2p files: S21/S11/S22/S12 at the design frequency, 2x and 3x, plus a sweep (match between parts, harmonic rejection). Small-signal only. A part with no file is named in leftOut, never filled in.

partNumbers.description: Signal order, input first; omit to use the design's.

user_request.description: Required: the end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. A figure not in them or in an earlier result is asked of the user (MCP elicitation), or refused.
